escalation_stages.name: Whispers and Quiet Mercies
escalation_stages.description: The Communion is a small, quiet movement performing rare, welcome miracles. Seraphine is unseen and unnamed to the party -- only her priests are visible.
escalation_stages.world_effects: A handful of villages have quietly benefited from Communion miracles. No political attention yet.

escalation_stages.name: The Congregation Grows
escalation_stages.description: The Communion goes public, gaining noble patrons and open shrines. Miracles are performed on schedule as demonstrations of faith. The first coerced (rather than volunteered) sacrifices begin.
new_abilities: Sanctioned Miracle (public healing/conversion ritual, draws crowds and converts)
escalation_stages.world_effects: The Gilded Reliquary is built. Nobles begin publicly endorsing the Communion. Crown attention is minimal but growing.

escalation_stages.name: The Cost Made Visible
escalation_stages.description: Imbalanced, rushed sacrifices start producing side effects the Communion can't fully control -- restless dead, memory-erased villages, unexplained monstrous phenomena. The Crown can no longer ignore it.
new_abilities: Raise the Unquiet (animates sacrifice-touched corpses as temporary allies)
escalation_stages.world_effects: The Forgetting Fields is discovered. Crown formally opens an investigation (Inquisitor Ashcombe). First undead-related incidents reported across the Hollow Reaches.

escalation_stages.name: Zealotry Ascendant
escalation_stages.description: Seraphine authorizes mass, involuntary sacrifice -- 'a hundred is a reasonable price.' Dissenters, including former believers, are assassinated or forcibly converted. The Ashen Accord becomes essential rather than optional.
new_abilities: Wholesale Communion (drains a settlement's collective vitality in a single ritual)
escalation_stages.world_effects: Open conflict between Communion zealots and the Crown. The Ashen Accord goes active. At least one named NPC dissenter is assassinated (Aldric Voss's doing).

escalation_stages.name: The Hollow Ascension
escalation_stages.description: Final ritual preparations begin at the Hollow Cathedral. The true scale of what's being attempted -- and what it will cost -- becomes clear to the party.
new_abilities: Saint's Aegis (near-total damage resistance while the ritual is actively channeling)
escalation_stages.world_effects: The Sundered Archive's erased history becomes accessible. The party learns the ritual would genuinely end disease, hunger, war, and death across Virelle -- and at what cost.

escalation_stages.name: The Saint Awakens
escalation_stages.description: The ritual completes or nearly completes. The Hollow Saint's true, independent intent is revealed -- it is unclear whether Seraphine is still in control of what she began.
new_abilities: The Saint's Voice (Seraphine periodically speaks with -- or is spoken over by -- something not entirely her)
escalation_stages.world_effects: Final confrontation at the Hollow Cathedral. This stage should not have a single 'correct' resolution -- structure the ending around the party's answer to the core question, not a stat-block victory condition alone.
